title: Phones, apps & payments
goal: Fix the wifi, log in and update apps, pay with QR codes and wallets, order online and talk about social media — with the English tech words Nepalis use and the right verbs to go with them.
intro:
Ask a Nepali friend about their phone and you'll hear more English than Nepali: **वाइफाइ**, **पासवर्ड**, **ओटीपी**, **स्क्यान**, **पेमेन्ट**, **डेलिभरी**, **पोस्ट**, **भाइरल**. What makes it Nepali is the grammar around them — **डाउनलोड गर्नु** when you do it, **डाउनलोड हुनु** when it happens, **नेट चलेन** 'the internet isn't working' — and that is what this unit drills.

You'll also practise the 'if' sentences you need with tech every day: **चलेन भने रिस्टार्ट गर** 'if it doesn't work, restart it', **मिले आजै पठाउनुहोस्** 'send it today if you can', and the formal **-एमा** you'll see in apps and bank messages.

vocab.note: नेट स्लो छ 'the internet is slow'. For people and traffic: बिस्तारै, ढिलो.

vocab.en: frozen, hung (of a phone or computer)
to work, run (of a device, app, card, connection)
vocab.note: नेट चलेन 'the internet isn't working'; कार्ड चल्छ? 'do you take cards?'. Causative: चलाउनु 'to use, operate'.
अपडेट गर्नु 'to update (it)'; अपडेट हुनु 'to get updated'.
Banks and apps send one by SMS. Never share it.
आईडी ह्याक भयो 'my account got hacked'.
Nepal runs on wallets like eSewa (इसेवा) and Khalti (खल्ती).
Also क्युआर कोड. Almost every shop has a QR sign at the counter.
पेमेन्ट भयो 'the payment went through'. Formal: भुक्तानी.

vocab.en: balance (in a wallet, account or phone)

vocab.note: Shops often ask for one as proof of payment.

phrases.en: How do you use this app?
Did the money go through or not?
Send me a screenshot, would you? (to a friend)
Follow me on Insta. (to a friend)

grammar.title: 'If' in practice: …भने, -ए, -एमा
grammar.body:
Unit 19 taught **…भने** 'if'. With phones, apps and payments you'll use conditions all the time — 'if it doesn't work…', 'if the money hasn't arrived…' — and Nepali has three forms.

**1. Past tense + भने — the everyday form.** The 'if' clause uses the **simple past** even about the future: नेट **चलेन भने** मलाई म्यासेज गर 'if the internet doesn't work, text me' (lit. 'if it didn't work'). Positive: पैसा **आयो भने** भन्नू 'tell me if the money comes'. The ending follows the person: तिमीले **पठायौ भने**, मैले **पाएँ भने**. The present is also possible (**छ भने** 'if there is'), especially with छ.

**2. The short form -ए (no भने).** **भए** 'if it is', **पुगे** 'if it's enough', **मिले** 'if possible', **गरे** 'if (you) do'. Negative with न-: **नचले**, **नआए**, **नभए**. This -ए is the same stem as in -एको, and it **doesn't change for person**: म गए, तिमी गए, ऊ गए 'if I / you / he go(es)'. It's very common in quick speech: **मिले** आजै पठाइदिनुहोस् 'send it today if you can'.

**3. -एमा — formal.** Apps, banks and notices write **-एमा** 'in case, if': समस्या **भएमा** सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस् 'in case of problems, contact us'. Recognise it; you'd rarely say it.

**Even if: -ए पनि.** **नचले पनि** 'even if it doesn't work', **जे भए पनि** 'whatever happens'.
**Otherwise: नत्र.** अहिल्यै तिर, **नत्र** अर्डर क्यान्सिल हुन्छ 'pay now, otherwise the order gets cancelled'.

The main clause is whatever you need — present, future or a command — and it always comes second.

examples.native: नेट चलेन भने मलाई म्यासेज गर।
examples.roman: neṭ chalena bhane malāi myāsej gara.
examples.en: If the internet isn't working, text me.
Tell me if the money arrives, OK?
If possible, please deliver it today.
If the OTP doesn't come, send it again.
In case of any problem, please contact us. (written)

examples.native: अहिल्यै तिर, नत्र अर्डर क्यान्सिल हुन्छ।
examples.roman: ahilyai tira, natra arḍar kyānsil hunchha.
examples.en: Pay now, otherwise the order gets cancelled.

grammar.title: English word + गर्नु or हुनु
grammar.body:
Nepali takes in English tech words by pairing them with **गर्नु** 'to do' or **हुनु** 'to become, happen'. Choosing the right one is the whole trick.

**गर्नु when someone does it** (transitive — there is a doer, usually with an object): **डाउनलोड गर्नु**, **सेयर गर्नु**, **ब्लक गर्नु**, **लगइन गर्नु**, **स्क्यान गर्नु**, **पोस्ट गर्नु**, **फलो गर्नु**, **ट्रान्सफर गर्नु**. In the past the doer takes **ले**: **मैले** फोटो सेयर **गरेँ**; **उसले** मलाई ब्लक **गर्‍यो**.

**हुनु when it happens by itself** (no doer): **डाउनलोड भयो** 'it has downloaded', **ह्याङ भयो** 'it froze', **ह्याक भयो** 'it got hacked', **भाइरल भयो** 'it went viral', **अपडेट भयो** 'it's updated', **पेमेन्ट भयो** 'the payment went through'. No ले.

Many words go both ways, like English active and passive: मैले एप **अपडेट गरेँ** 'I updated the app' / एप **अपडेट भयो** 'the app got updated'. The negative shows the difference clearly: **डाउनलोड गरिनँ** 'I didn't download it' vs **डाउनलोड भएन** 'it didn't download'.

Everything you know about गर्नु still works: the favour form **सेयर गरिदेऊ न** 'share it for me', **अपडेट गर्नुपर्छ** 'it needs updating', **लगइन गर्न सकिनँ** / **लगइन गर्न मिलेन** 'I couldn't log in'.

A few things take their own verbs. **चल्नु** 'to work, run': नेट **चलेन**, कार्ड **चल्छ?**; its causative **चलाउनु** 'to use': एप **चलाउनु**. And when something breaks or runs out, the device is the subject: फोन **बिग्रियो** 'my phone broke', ब्याट्री **सकियो** 'the battery died'.

examples.en: Did the payment go through? — Yes, it did.
I forgot my password and couldn't log in.

dialogue.title: Saturday momo order
dialogue.setting: Saturday afternoon in a rented flat in Kathmandu. Flatmates Kriti and Aayush try to order momos on a food-delivery app while the wifi keeps dropping.

lines.speaker: Kriti
lines.native: आयुष, वाइफाइ चलेको छ? मेरो फोनमा त केही खुलेन।
lines.roman: Āyus, wāiphāi chaleko chha? mero phonmā ta kehi khulena.
lines.en: Aayush, is the wifi working? Nothing's loading on my phone.

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: फेरि गयो होला। राउटर रिस्टार्ट गरेर हेर न।
lines.roman: pheri gayo holā. rāuṭar risṭārṭ garera hera na.
lines.en: It's probably dropped again. Try restarting the router.

lines.speaker: Kriti
lines.native: ल, चल्यो! अब खाना अर्डर गरौँ, भोक लाग्यो।
lines.roman: la, chalyo! aba khānā arḍar garauṃ, bhok lāgyo.
lines.en: There — it's working! Let's order food now, I'm starving.

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: एपमा मःम हेर त। आज छुट छ रे!
lines.roman: epmā momo hera ta. āja chhuṭ chha re!
lines.en: Look for momos on the app. Apparently there's a discount today!

lines.speaker: Kriti
lines.native: साँच्चै! दुई प्लेट झोल मःम अर्डर गरेँ। नगद कि इसेवा?
lines.roman: sāṃchchai! dui pleṭ jhol momo arḍar gareṃ. nagad ki Isewā?
lines.en: So there is! I've ordered two plates of jhol momo. Cash or eSewa?

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.en: Pay with eSewa, if you've got enough balance.

lines.speaker: Kriti
lines.native: खै, पेमेन्ट भएन! ओटीपी नै आएन।
lines.roman: khai, pemenṭ bhaena! oṭipi nai āena.
lines.en: Ugh, the payment didn't go through! The OTP never came.

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: नेटवर्क नभएर होला। ओटीपी नआए फेरि माग।
lines.roman: neṭwark nabhaera holā. oṭipi naāe pheri māga.
lines.en: Probably no signal. If it doesn't come, ask for a new one.

lines.speaker: Kriti
lines.native: आयो, आयो! पेमेन्ट भयो। चालीस मिनेटमा डेलिभरी हुन्छ रे।
lines.roman: āyo, āyo! pemenṭ bhayo. chālis mineṭmā ḍelibhari hunchha re.
lines.en: It's here! Payment done. It says delivery in forty minutes.

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: चालीस मिनेट? तबसम्म म भोकले मर्छु!
lines.roman: chālis mineṭ? tabasamma ma bhokle marchhu!
lines.en: Forty minutes? I'll have starved to death by then!

lines.speaker: Kriti
lines.native: डेलिभरी दाइले फोन गर्नुभयो — घर भेटिएन रे। लोकेसन पठाइदिऊँ?
lines.roman: ḍelibhari dāile phon garnubhayo — ghar bheṭiena re. lokesan paṭhāidiuṃ?
lines.en: The delivery guy called — he can't find the house. Shall I send him the location?

lines.speaker: Aayush
lines.native: पठाइदेऊ, अनि गेटमा गएर पर्ख। हाम्रो गल्लीमा कोही पुग्दैन!
lines.roman: paṭhāideu, ani geṭmā gaera parkha. hāmro gallimā kohi pugdaina!
lines.en: Send it, and go and wait at the gate. Nobody ever finds our alley!

culture:
Nepal went from cash to QR codes very fast. Tea shops, vegetable stalls and taxi drivers display a **क्युआर** card, and the usual question is **क्युआर छ?** or **स्क्यान गरूँ?**. Payments go through wallets such as **eSewa** and **Khalti** or a bank's **मोबाइल बैंकिङ** app, and shopkeepers often ask to see the screen or a **स्क्रिनसट** as proof. Card machines are much rarer, and cash (नगद) is still king in villages.

Addresses in Nepal rarely have street numbers, so delivery riders (**डेलिभरी दाइ**) and ride-app drivers phone you on the way, and you guide them by landmarks — **चोकबाट दायाँ, नीलो गेट** — or by sending your **लोकेसन**. Online shopping (Daraz is the biggest site) is often cash on delivery.

Facebook and Messenger are used by every generation, Viber is where family groups live, and TikTok and Instagram belong to the young. Nobody says सामाजिक सञ्जाल or भुक्तानी in conversation — those are newspaper words. Mixing English into Nepali this way is completely normal, but the grammar stays Nepali: **पोस्ट गर्नु**, **भाइरल हुनु**, **नेट चलेन**.

tip.title: When things stop working: चल्नु and हुनु
tip.body:
- The device or connection is the subject: नेट **चलेन** 'the internet isn't working', फोन ह्याङ **भयो** 'my phone froze'.
- So the verb is 3rd person, with no ले: वाइफाइ **चलेन**, not चलिनँ.
- *You* fix it with **गर्नु**: रिस्टार्ट **गर**.
tip.pattern: X चलेन  ·  X ह्याङ भयो  ·  रिस्टार्ट गर

sentences.roman: risṭārṭ garepachhi phon chalyo.

sentences.roman: wāiphāiko pāswarḍ birseṃ.
sentences.en: I've forgotten the wifi password.

tip.title: English word + गर्नु or हुनु
tip.body:
- **गर्नु** when someone does it: डाउनलोड **गर्नु**, अपडेट **गर्नु**, लगइन **गर्नु** — with **ले** in the past: मैले अपडेट **गरेँ**.
- **हुनु** when it happens by itself: डाउनलोड **भयो**, आईडी ह्याक **भयो** — no ले.
- Negative: डाउनलोड **गरिनँ** 'I didn't download it' vs डाउनलोड **भएन** 'it didn't download'.

sentences.native: मैले नयाँ एप डाउनलोड गरेँ।
sentences.roman: maile nayāṃ ep ḍāunloḍ gareṃ.
sentences.en: I've downloaded a new app.

sentences.native: एप अझै डाउनलोड भएन।
sentences.roman: ep ajhai ḍāunloḍ bhaena.
sentences.en: The app still hasn't downloaded.

sentences.native: मैले फोन अपडेट गरेँ, अब धेरै स्लो भयो।
sentences.roman: maile phon apḍeṭ gareṃ, aba dherai slo bhayo.
sentences.en: I updated my phone and now it's really slow.

sentences.native: ओटीपी आएन, लगइन गर्न सकिनँ।
sentences.roman: oṭipi āena, lagin garna sakinaṃ.
sentences.en: The OTP didn't come, so I couldn't log in.

sentences.native: भाइको आईडी कसैले ह्याक गर्‍यो।
sentences.roman: bhāiko āiḍi kasaile hyāk garyo.
sentences.en: Someone hacked my brother's account.

sentences.native: नयाँ पासवर्ड राखेँ, अब ह्याक हुँदैन होला।
sentences.roman: nayāṃ pāswarḍ rākheṃ, aba hyāk huṃdaina holā.
sentences.en: I've set a new password; it shouldn't get hacked now.

sentences.native: अपडेट भएपछि एप राम्रोसँग चल्यो।
sentences.roman: apḍeṭ bhaepachhi ep rāmrosaṃga chalyo.
sentences.en: After the update the app worked fine.

sentences.native: यो एप चलाउन लगइन गर्नुपर्छ?
sentences.roman: yo ep chalāuna lagin garnuparchha?
sentences.en: Do you have to log in to use this app?

sentences.native: ओटीपी कसैलाई नदिनुहोस्।
sentences.roman: oṭipi kasailāi nadinuhos.
sentences.en: Don't give your OTP to anyone.

tip.title: 'If…' in everyday speech
tip.body:
- Everyday 'if' = **past tense + भने**, even about the future: पैसा **आयो भने** भन्नू 'tell me if the money comes'.
- Negative: **चलेन भने**, **पुगेन भने**.
- Short form **-ए** (no भने), the same for every person: **मिले**, **नभए**.
- 'Even if': **-ए पनि**: कम **भए पनि**.

sentences.native: नगद छैन भने क्युआर स्क्यान गर्नुहोस्।
sentences.roman: nagad chhaina bhane kyuār skyān garnuhos.
sentences.en: If you don't have cash, scan the QR code.

sentences.native: वालेटमा ब्यालेन्स पुगेन भने बैंकबाट ट्रान्सफर गर।

sentences.en: If there isn't enough in your wallet, transfer some from the bank.

sentences.native: पैसा पठायौ भने मलाई भन है।
sentences.roman: paisā paṭhāyau bhane malāi bhana hai.
sentences.en: Tell me if you send the money, OK?

sentences.native: पेमेन्ट नभए अर्डर आउँदैन।
sentences.roman: pemenṭ nabhae arḍar āuṃdaina.
sentences.en: If the payment doesn't go through, the order won't come.

sentences.native: मिले इसेवाबाट तिर्छु, नत्र नगद दिन्छु।
sentences.roman: mile Isewābāṭa tirchhu, natra nagad dinchhu.
sentences.en: I'll pay by eSewa if I can, otherwise cash.

sentences.native: ब्यालेन्स कम भए पनि पेमेन्ट भयो।
sentences.roman: byālens kam bhae pani pemenṭ bhayo.
sentences.en: Even though the balance was low, the payment went through.

sentences.roman: mobāil baiṅkiṅ chha bhane paisā turuntai jānchha.

sentences.native: दाइ, क्युआर छ भने म स्क्यान गर्छु।
sentences.roman: dāi, kyuār chha bhane ma skyān garchhu.

sentences.en: Even when I scanned the QR code, the payment didn't go through.

tip.title: Formal 'if' and 'otherwise': -एमा, नत्र
tip.body:
- Apps, banks and shops write **-एमा** for 'if / in case': समस्या **भएमा** फोन गर्नुहोस्.
- **नत्र** 'otherwise': अहिल्यै तिर, **नत्र** अर्डर क्यान्सिल हुन्छ.
- In speech the same idea uses **भने** or **-ए**: आज अर्डर **गरे** भोलि आउँछ.

sentences.native: सामान राम्रो नभएमा फिर्ता गर्न सकिन्छ।
sentences.roman: sāmān rāmro nabhaemā phirtā garna sakinchha.
sentences.en: If the item isn't any good, it can be returned.

sentences.native: डेलिभरीमा समस्या भएमा यो नम्बरमा फोन गर्नुहोस्।
sentences.roman: ḍelibharimā samasyā bhaemā yo nambarmā phon garnuhos.
sentences.en: If there is a problem with the delivery, call this number.

sentences.native: पैसा तिरेको स्क्रिनसट पठाइदिनुहोस्, नत्र अर्डर हुँदैन।
sentences.roman: paisā tireko skrinsaṭ paṭhāidinuhos, natra arḍar huṃdaina.
sentences.en: Please send a screenshot of the payment, otherwise the order won't go through.

sentences.native: आज अर्डर गरे भोलि डेलिभरी हुन्छ।
sentences.roman: āja arḍar gare bholi ḍelibhari hunchha.
sentences.en: If you order today, it'll be delivered tomorrow.

sentences.native: अहिल्यै तिर्नुहोस्, नत्र छुट सकिन्छ।
sentences.roman: ahilyai tirnuhos, natra chhuṭ sakinchha.
sentences.en: Pay right now, otherwise the discount ends.

sentences.native: डेलिभरी आएन भने फेरि म्यासेज गर।
sentences.roman: ḍelibhari āena bhane pheri myāsej gara.
sentences.en: If the delivery doesn't come, message them again.

sentences.native: डेलिभरी दाइ गेटमा आइपुग्नुभयो।
sentences.roman: ḍelibhari dāi geṭmā āipugnubhayo.
sentences.en: The delivery guy has got to the gate.

sentences.native: मैले पेमेन्टको स्क्रिनसट पठाइसकेँ।
sentences.roman: maile pemenṭko skrinsaṭ paṭhāisakeṃ.
sentences.en: I've already sent the screenshot of the payment.

tip.title: Social media verbs
tip.body:
- What *you* do takes **गर्नु**: पोस्ट **गर्नु**, लाइक **गर्नु**, कमेन्ट **गर्नु**, सेयर **गर्नु**, फलो **गर्नु**, ब्लक **गर्नु**.
- What *happens* takes **हुनु**: भाइरल **भयो**, ह्याक **भयो**.
- Favour form: सेयर **गरिदेऊ** न 'share it for me'.
tip.pattern: X गर्नु (you do it)  ·  X हुनु (it happens)

sentences.native: मेरो फोटोमा कसैले लाइक गरेन!
sentences.roman: mero phoṭomā kasaile lāik garena!
sentences.en: Nobody liked my photo!

sentences.native: यो भिडियो सबै साथीलाई सेयर गरिदेऊ न।
sentences.roman: yo bhiḍiyo sabai sāthilāi seyar garideu na.
sentences.en: Share this video with all your friends, would you?

sentences.native: उसको पोस्ट एकै दिनमा भाइरल भयो।
sentences.roman: usko posṭ ekai dinmā bhāiral bhayo.
sentences.en: His post went viral in a single day.

sentences.native: मैले उसलाई ब्लक गरेँ, धेरै दिक्क लाग्यो।
sentences.roman: maile uslāi blak gareṃ, dherai dikka lāgyo.
sentences.en: I blocked him — he was so annoying.

sentences.native: तिमीले मेरो पोस्टमा कमेन्ट किन गरेनौ?
sentences.roman: timile mero posṭmā kamenṭ kina garenau?
sentences.en: Why didn't you comment on my post?

sentences.native: उनलाई फलो गर, धेरै रमाइला भिडियो पोस्ट गर्छिन्।
sentences.roman: unlāi phalo gara, dherai ramāilā bhiḍiyo posṭ garchhin.
sentences.en: Follow her — she posts really funny videos.

sentences.native: अचेल सबै सोसल मिडियामा व्यस्त छन्।
sentences.roman: achel sabai sosal miḍiyāmā byasta chhan.
sentences.en: Everyone's busy on social media these days.

sentences.native: मैले पोस्ट गरेको फोटो हेर्‍यौ?
sentences.roman: maile posṭ gareko phoṭo heryau?
sentences.en: Did you see the photo I posted?
